means.example-sentence: My younger sister screamed loudly at the sight of a big cockroach in her room.
means.sentence-jp: 私の妹は自分の部屋で大きなゴキブリを見て、大きく悲鳴を上げた。

cloze.maskedText: My younger sister screamed loudly ____ a big cockroach in her room.

notes: at the mere sight of ~ なら「〜を見ただけで」。in [within] sight of ~ は「〜の見えるところで」。
